section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participant sample for a single study consisting of 92 college women with a mean age of 19.7 years. The ethnic composition was predominantly Caucasian (50%), with smaller percentages of East Asian, South Asian, Black/African, and other ethnicities. BMI was calculated from self-reported weight and height, with a mean of 22.62 (SD = 3.41) and a range of 15.6 to 35.
